title: Cities — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The cities used across HCMv3 — most visibly as an employee's place of birth.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: State
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from State master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The state or region the city is in, from the states list.

Why it matters. Recorded for reference; nothing else uses it.
